entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF78-9901.
Certainly. Let me pull that up for you... VF78-9901. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 15 days ago. I can definitely help you get started with that.
Great. So what do I do?
Just to confirm, what was the reason for the return?

Look, it's a bit of a story. The VeloBand **was a gift** for my sister. The problem is, I was **traveling** for work right after it arrived and couldn't give it to her immediately. While I was gone, she had a small emergency and ended up in the **hospital** for a few days.
Oh my, I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope she's doing alright now.

She's fine, but the whole thing threw my timing off. By the time I could give it to her, she'd already bought one herself. Then I tried to do the return online yesterday and your **website crashed** on me three times in a row. I'm pretty frustrated.

I can absolutely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the trouble with our site. That is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now.

Okay... I see the issue here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window from the day of delivery. Since the item was delivered 15 days ago, the system is showing it as outside the return period.

Ten days? Are you serious? After everything I just told you? I saw a 90-day policy on your site. You can't just hide a 10-day limit in the **fine print** and expect people to see it. That's ridiculous.

I completely understand your perspective, and I do apologize for the confusion. The standard 90-day policy applies to most of our apparel, but for electronic items like the Pulse, there are stricter policies for hygiene and data security reasons. Unfortunately, that 10-day window is a hard limit in our system that I can't override.
So that's it? I'm just stuck with a $150 device I can't use? This is unacceptable service.

I know this isn't the answer you were hoping for, and I want to make this right. While I can't process a refund back to your credit card, I can absolutely offer you a full store credit for the entire value of the VeloBand Pulse.

Furthermore, for all the trouble you've gone through with your sister being in the hospital and our website issues, I'd like to add an additional $25 inconvenience credit to your account. You'd have a total of $175 to use on any other VeloFit gear, with no expiration date.
Wait, so... the full amount as store credit, plus an extra $25?
That's correct. It will be available in your VeloFit account immediately.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually a great solution. I really wasn't expecting that. Thank you. I appreciate you finding a way to help.

Of course. I'm glad we could find a resolution for you. I've just applied the credit to your account now. You should receive a confirmation email in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Sam. You were very helpful.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and please send our best wishes to your sister for a speedy recovery. Have a great day.
